name: Ledger facts proposal PR (review required)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: ledger-facts-proposal
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  propose:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Execute only on trusted main; no untrusted PR code.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: true
      - name: Validate offline generator
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_development_ledger_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Validate index proposal generation
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_development_index_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Verify safe event triggers
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_ledger_event_triggers.py' -v
      - name: Validate proposal safety checks
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_verify_ledger_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Build read-only snapshot and proposal
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/development_inventory.py
          python3 scripts/development_ledger_proposal.py
          python3 scripts/verify_ledger_proposal.py
          python3 scripts/development_index_proposal.py
      - name: Save generated proposal for inspection
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ledger-proposal-diagnostics
          path: |
            inventory-output/report.json
            inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md
            inventory-output/index-proposed.md
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Open review-only PR when needed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if cmp -s docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md && cmp -s docs/DEVELOPMENT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md inventory-output/index-proposed.md; then
            echo 'No ledger or index changes; no PR required.'
            exit 0
          fi
          if gh pr list --state open --json headRefName --jq '[.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"))] | length' | grep -qv '^0$'; then
            echo 'An automation review PR is already open; leaving it for review.'
            exit 0
          fi
          branch="automation/ledger-facts-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git checkout -b "$branch"
          cp inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md
          cp inventory-output/index-proposed.md docs/DEVELOPMENT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md
          git add docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md docs/DEVELOPMENT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md
          git commit -m 'docs: propose factual GitHub ledger and operations index snapshot'
          git push origin "$branch"
          if ! gh pr create --base main --head "$branch" \
            --title 'docs: review GitHub facts in development ledger and operations index' \
            --body 'Automatically generated factual PR snapshot only. Review required; no automatic merge. Does not assert implementation, production deployment, or verification completion.'; then
            echo 'ERROR: GitHub Actions could not create the ledger PR. Check repository Actions permissions for PR creation.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a deterministic review-only proposal for the operations index."""
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

START = "<!-- OPERATIONS_INVENTORY_START -->"
END = "<!-- OPERATIONS_INVENTORY_END -->"

def update(original, report):
    snapshot = report.get("snapshot")
    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing inventory")
    branches = snapshot.get("branches")
    prs = snapshot.get("prs")
    issues = snapshot.get("issues")
    if not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in (branches, prs, issues)):
        raise ValueError("Incomplete inventory")
    if report.get("default_branch") not in branches:
        raise ValueError("Default branch missing")
    if not re.search(r"^\| [MA]-[0-9]+ \|", original, re.M):
        raise ValueError("Canonical case list missing")
    lines = ["## GitHub自動棚卸し（確認用の事実）", "",
             "> これはPRの状態だけを示し、開発完了・本番反映・実装重複を意味しません。",
             "",
             "開発台帳: [DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md](DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md)",
             "",
             "| Open PR | タイトル | Head branch |",
             "|---|---|---|"]
    count = 0
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]) if str(item[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict) or pr.get("state") != "open":
            continue
        if str(pr.get("head_ref", "")).startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"):
            continue
        title = " ".join(str(pr.get("title", "")).split()).replace("|", "/")[:100]
        branch = " ".join(str(pr.get("head_ref", "")).split()).replace("|", "/")[:100]
        lines.append(f"| #{number} | {title} | {branch} |")
        count += 1
    if not count:
        lines.append("| — | なし | — |")
    lines += ["", "全ブランチのmain差分と滞留候補はGitHub Actionsのdevelopment-inventory成果物を参照。",
              "既存案件ID・判断欄は変更しません。", ""]
    block = START + "\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n" + END
    if START in original or END in original:
        if original.count(START) != 1 or original.count(END) != 1 or original.index(START) >= original.index(END):
            raise ValueError("Corrupt section markers")
        proposed = original[:original.index(START)] + block + original[original.index(END) + len(END):]
    else:
        proposed = original.rstrip() + "\n\n" + block + "\n"
    if len(proposed.encode("utf-8")) > 2000000:
        raise ValueError("Proposal too large")
    return proposed

def main():
    report = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    original = Path("docs/DEVELOPMENT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    proposed = update(original, report)
    if update(proposed, report) != proposed:
        raise ValueError("Not idempotent")
    target = Path("inventory-output/index-proposed.md")
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(proposed, encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

- 毎日10:17 JSTにread-onlyのGitHub Actions棚卸し。`development-inventory` artifactに `report.json` / `summary.md` を30日保持。**台帳へ自動反映はされない**。
- 週次は新規・消滅・状態変化の候補を確認し、この索引に**変更があった案件だけ**追記・更新する。週次詳細照合は自動化済みではない。
- 未整理ブランチの原資料: [一次分類](audits/BRANCH_TRIAGE_20261101.md) / [初回調査](audits/INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION_20261101.md)。全件の履歴はGitHub Actions成果物を参照。
- 実装、予測精度の検証、DB、Push、デプロイ、ブランチ削除は担当ソラの領域。ここでは発見事項・所在・引継ぎ先だけを記録する。

## 日次レポートと週次差分の確認手順
1. GitHub Actionsの `Development inventory (read-only)` の最新**成功**runを開き、`development-inventory` artifactの `report.json` / `summary.md` を取得する。失敗・未実行なら前回値を最新値と扱わず、実行日時を明記する。
2. 前回の成功runと比較する対象は、ブランチの追加・消滅・head変化、PRの新規・open/closed/merged変化、Issueの新規・状態変化、長期停滞候補の増減。**集計件数の差だけで作業完了・未統合・削除可能とは判断しない**。
3. 変化を見つけたら、対応する案件IDと証拠（PR・commit・ブランチ・run ID）を照合する。新規案件だけIDを追加し、既存案件は状態・次の一手・確認日を更新する。変更なしなら台帳の不要な書き換えはしない。
4. 旧ブランチの保全・削除判断、アプリ実装、DB、Push、本番変更は担当者と別途判断する。週次差分確認は**手順の定義のみ**で、現時点で自動実行されない。

### 更新時の最小記録
`確認日（JST） / 案件ID / 変更前→変更後 / 証拠URL・run ID / 引継ぎ先 / 次の一手 / 未確認事項`。

## 第4段階：台帳の安全な自動更新（導入前の運用契約）

- **事実ログと判断欄を分離する。** GitHub APIで確認できたPR番号・タイトル・状態・head SHA・更新日時・証拠URLのみを、機械管理の独立セクションへ追記する。開発案件の進捗、完了、本番稼働、実機確認、担当者の判断欄は変更しない。
- **PR方式を優先する。** 自動化は専用ブランチ上に更新案を生成し、差分がある場合のみ台帳更新PRを作る。初期段階は自動マージせず、実データの正確性と重複防止を確認してから限定的な自動マージを検討する。
- **証拠が不足する場合は更新しない。** 比較不能、API失敗、分類の曖昧さ、100件を超えるファイル一覧、既存台帳との競合は確認待ちとして記録する。PRマージだけで開発完了と判断しない。
- **冪等性。** PR番号とhead SHAなどの安定した識別子を使い、再実行しても同じ事実を重複追記しない。自動化自身のPRは製品開発案件へ割り当てない。
- **安全境界。** アプリコード、DB、認証、Push、デプロイ、ブランチ削除は操作しない。GitHub Actionsの書込権限は台帳更新専用ジョブに限定し、既存のread-only棚卸しは維持する。

この節は設計合意の記録であり、台帳の自動書込みが稼働していることを意味しない。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only branch-to-main comparisons. Report evidence, never infer feature completion."""
import json
import os
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

def compare_rows(report, fetch):
    snapshot = report.get("snapshot") or {}
    branches = snapshot.get("branches") or {}
    default = report.get("default_branch")
    if not isinstance(branches, dict) or default not in branches:
        raise ValueError("Incomplete branch snapshot")
    rows = []
    for name, sha in sorted(branches.items()):
        if name == default:
            continue
        if not isinstance(sha, str) or len(sha) != 40:
            rows.append((name, "inconclusive: missing SHA", "", "", ""))
            continue
        path = "/repos/" + urllib.parse.quote(report["repository"], safe="/") + "/compare/" + urllib.parse.quote(default, safe="") + "..." + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe="")
        try:
            data = fetch(path)
            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                raise ValueError("Unexpected API result")
            status = data.get("status", "unknown")
            ahead = data.get("ahead_by", "?")
            behind = data.get("behind_by", "?")
            files = data.get("files", [])
            if not isinstance(files, list):
                raise ValueError("Missing files list")
            # GitHub compare returns a capped file list. Do not claim coverage at or near the cap.
            coverage = "partial/unknown" if len(files) >= 300 or ahead == "?" else "API-reported"
            sample = ", ".join(str(f.get("filename", "")) for f in files[:8] if isinstance(f, dict))
            rows.append((name, str(status), str(ahead), str(behind), coverage + ": " + sample))
        except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as error:
            rows.append((name, "inconclusive: " + type(error).__name__, "", "", ""))
    return rows

def render(rows):
    lines = ["# Branch-to-main evidence (read-only)", "",
             "This is GitHub compare metadata, not proof that a feature is missing, complete, or safe to merge.",
             "Review full diff, closed PRs, and ledger before taking action.", "",
             "| Branch | Compare status | Ahead | Behind | File evidence |",
             "|---|---|---:|---:|---|"]
    for fields in rows:
        escaped = [str(value).replace("|", "|").replace("\n", " ") for value in fields]
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(escaped) + " |")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def main():
    report = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    repo = report["repository"]
    token = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
    def fetch(path):
        req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com" + path, headers={
            "Authorization": "Bearer " + token,
            "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
            "User-Agent": "branch-to-main-inventory"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as response:
            return json.load(response)
    rows = compare_rows(report, fetch)
    Path("inventory-output/branch-comparison.md").write_text(render(rows), encoding="utf-8")
    print("Recorded comparisons for " + str(len(rows)) + " branches in " + repo)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a review-only reconciliation report for the canonical operations index."""
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

def render(index, report):
    snapshot = report.get("snapshot")
    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing snapshot")
    branches = snapshot.get("branches")
    prs = snapshot.get("prs")
    issues = snapshot.get("issues")
    if not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in (branches, prs, issues)):
        raise ValueError("Incomplete snapshot")
    cases = re.findall(r"^\| ([MA]-[0-9]+) \|", index, flags=re.M)
    candidates = report.get("review_candidates")
    if not cases or not isinstance(candidates, list):
        raise ValueError("Missing canonical cases or candidates")
    lines = ["# Index reconciliation (review only)", "",
             "This report does not edit the canonical index or ledger.", "",
             f"Indexed cases: {len(cases)}",
             f"Branches including main: {len(branches)}",
             f"Historical PRs: {len(prs)}",
             f"Open issues: {len(issues)}", "",
             "## Branches needing main and ledger comparison", "",
             "| Branch | Head SHA | Historical PR |", "|---|---|---|"]
    for item in sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: str(x.get("name", ""))):
        name = item.get("name")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or name not in branches:
            raise ValueError("Invalid branch candidate")
        sha = branches[name]
        if not isinstance(sha, str):
            raise ValueError("Invalid branch SHA")
        name = name.replace("|", "|").replace("\n", " ")
        lines.append(f"| `{name}` | `{sha[:12]}` | {bool(item.get('historical_pr_found'))} |")
    lines += ["", "Compare each candidate with main, historical PRs, and the existing ledger.",
              "Do not infer unfinished work or duplicate code from branch names.", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)

def main():
    index = Path("docs/DEVELOPMENT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    report = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    output = Path("inventory-output/index-review.md")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(render(index, report), encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only GitHub development inventory. No branch/PR/Issue mutations."""
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

REPO = os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"]
TOKEN = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
NOW = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
STALE_DAYS = int(os.environ.get("STALE_DAYS", "14"))
API = "https://api.github.com"

def get(path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + path, headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN,
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        "User-Agent": "development-inventory-readonly",
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)

def pages(path):
    result = []
    page = 1
    while True:
        separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
        batch = get(path + separator + "per_page=100&page=" + str(page))
        if not isinstance(batch, list):
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected API response")
        result.extend(batch)
        if len(batch) < 100:
            return result
        page += 1

def age(timestamp):
    if not timestamp:
        return None
    updated = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return (NOW - updated).days

def main():
    repo = urllib.parse.quote(REPO, safe="/")
    metadata = get("/repos/" + repo)
    default = metadata["default_branch"]
    branches = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/branches")
    all_prs = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/pulls?state=all")
    prs = [p for p in all_prs if p["state"] == "open"]
    issues = [item for item in pages("/repos/" + repo + "/issues?state=open") if "pull_request" not in item]
    pr_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    historical_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in all_prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    findings = []
    for branch in branches:
        name = branch["name"]
        if name == default:
            continue
        # No-PR does NOT mean unfinished. Report only as a review candidate.
        if name not in pr_heads:
            findings.append({"type": "branch_without_open_pr", "name": name,
                             "historical_pr_found": name in historical_heads,
                             "url": "https://github.com/" + REPO + "/tree/" + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe="")})
    stale_prs = [{"number": p["number"], "title": p["title"], "days": age(p["updated_at"]),
                  "url": p["html_url"]} for p in prs if age(p["updated_at"]) is not None and age(p["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    stale_issues = [{"number": i["number"], "title": i["title"], "days": age(i["updated_at"]),
                     "url": i["html_url"]} for i in issues if age(i["updated_at"]) is not None and age(i["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    report = {"repository": REPO, "generated_at": NOW.isoformat(), "default_branch": default,
              "branch_count": len(branches), "open_pr_count": len(prs),
              "open_issue_count": len(issues), "historical_pr_count": len(all_prs), "review_candidates": findings,
              "stale_prs": stale_prs, "stale_issues": stale_issues,
              "caveat": "Candidates are NOT proof of unfinished work. Compare main, merged/closed PRs, and canonical ledger before action."}
    # Stable snapshot for comparison across successful scheduled/manual runs.
    report["snapshot"] = {
        "branches": {b["name"]: b.get("commit", {}).get("sha") for b in branches},
        "prs": {str(p["number"]): {"state": ("merged" if p.get("merged_at") else p["state"]),
                                  "head": p["head"].get("sha"), "updated_at": p["updated_at"],
                                  "title": p.get("title", ""), "body": (p.get("body") or "")[:2000],
                                  "head_ref": p["head"].get("ref", "")}
                for p in all_prs},
        "issues": {str(i["number"]): {"state": "open", "updated_at": i["updated_at"]} for i in issues},
    }
    os.makedirs("inventory-output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("inventory-output/report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    summary = ["# Development inventory (read-only)", "",
               "Repository: " + REPO, "Generated (UTC): " + NOW.isoformat(), "",
               "| Metric | Count |", "|---|---:|",
               "| Branches including default | " + str(len(branches)) + " |",
               "| Open PRs | " + str(len(prs)) + " |",
               "| Open issues | " + str(len(issues)) + " |",
               "| Branches without open PR (review only) | " + str(len(findings)) + " |",
               "| Stale PRs (>= " + str(STALE_DAYS) + " days) | " + str(len(stale_prs)) + " |",
               "| Stale issues | " + str(len(stale_issues)) + " |", "",
               "**Do not mark branches unfinished or delete them based on this report.**",
               "Consult the project's canonical ledger, closed/merged PRs and main code first.", "",
               "## Stale PRs"]
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(p["number"]) + "](" + p["url"] + ") (" + str(p["days"]) + "d): " + p["title"].replace("\n", " ") for p in stale_prs)
    summary.append("\n## Stale issues")
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(i["number"]) + "](" + i["url"] + ") (" + str(i["days"]) + "d): " + i["title"].replace("\n", " ") for i in stale_issues)
    summary.append("\nBranch candidates are available in report.json artifact.")
    text = "\n".join(summary) + "\n"
    with open("inventory-output/summary.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/null"), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    print(text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (urllib.error.URLError, KeyError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print("Inventory failed: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a deterministic, review-only GitHub facts section from inventory report."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

START = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_START -->"
END = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_END -->"

def render(report):
    prs = report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs", {})
    lines = ["## GitHub自動取得の事実（確認用）", "",
             "> この欄はPRメタデータの記録であり、開発完了・本番反映の認定ではありません。", "",
             "| PR | タイトル | 状態 | head SHA | 更新日時 |",
             "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]) if str(item[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict):
            continue
        if str(pr.get("head_ref", "")).startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"):
            continue
        state = str(pr.get("state", "unknown")).replace("|", "/").replace("\n", " ")
        sha = str(pr.get("head", ""))[:40]
        updated = str(pr.get("updated_at", ""))[:35]
        title = " ".join(str(pr.get("title", "")).split()).replace("|", "/")[:120]
        lines.append(f"| #{number} | {title} | {state} | `{sha}` | {updated} |")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def update(ledger, report):
    section = START + "\n" + render(report) + END
    if START in ledger or END in ledger:
        if ledger.count(START) != 1 or ledger.count(END) != 1 or ledger.index(START) > ledger.index(END):
            raise ValueError("Invalid managed markers; refuse to change ledger")
        return ledger[:ledger.index(START)] + section + ledger[ledger.index(END) + len(END):]
    return ledger.rstrip() + "\n\n" + section + "\n"

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--report", default="inventory-output/report.json")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", default="docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = json.loads(Path(args.report).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs"), dict):
        raise ValueError("PR snapshot missing; refuse to propose ledger update")
    proposed = update(Path(args.ledger).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), report)
    target = Path(args.output)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(proposed, encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Enrich the existing PR handoff queue with fail-closed approval routing.

Read-only. Decisions are advisory, never proof of review or approval.
"""
import json
import os
import urllib.error
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from scripts.pr_promotion_review import inspect
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    from pr_promotion_review import inspect

ROUTES = {
    "owner_approval_required": "ユーザー承認が必要（担当ソラが先に内容確認）",
    "maintainer_review_required": "担当ソラの確認が必要",
    "hold_draft": "Draftのため保留",
    "hold_incomplete": "情報不足のため保留",
    "hold_invalid": "判定不可のため保留",
}


def clean(value, limit=120):
    return " ".join(str(value).split()).replace("|", "/").replace("[", "(").replace("]", ")")[:limit]


def build(report, inspect_pr=inspect):
    repo = report.get("repository")
    snapshot = report.get("snapshot")
    prs = snapshot.get("prs") if isinstance(snapshot, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(repo, str) or not repo or not isinstance(prs, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing repository or PR snapshot")
    rows = []
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda pair: int(pair[0]) if str(pair[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict) or pr.get("state") != "open":
            continue
        try:
            classification = inspect_pr(repo, int(number))
            decision = classification.get("decision")
            if decision not in ROUTES:
                decision = "hold_invalid"
                reason = "Unknown classifier result"
            elif classification.get("head_sha") != pr.get("head"):
                decision = "hold_incomplete"
                reason = "PR changed during inventory; recheck required"
            else:
                reason = classification.get("reason", "")
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, TimeoutError) as error:
            decision = "hold_incomplete"
            reason = "PR classification unavailable: " + type(error).__name__
        rows.append({"number": int(number), "title": clean(pr.get("title", "")),
                     "updated_at": clean(pr.get("updated_at", ""), 35),
                     "decision": decision, "route": ROUTES[decision], "reason": clean(reason, 180),
                     "head_sha": pr.get("head")})
    return rows


def render(repo, rows):
    lines = [
        "# PR確認待ち・承認経路（読み取り専用）", "",
        "これは担当ソラ向けの確認キューです。判定はファイル名等に基づく保守的な一次分類で、承認・実機確認・本番反映を意味しません。",
        "ユーザー承認が必要なPRは、担当ソラが変更内容・CI・本番影響を確認してからユーザーへ相談してください。", "",
        "| PR | タイトル | 次の確認者 | 判定 | 更新日時 |",
        "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
    ]
    for row in rows:
        lines.append(
            f"| [#{row['number']}](https://github.com/{repo}/pull/{row['number']})"
            f" | {row['title']} | {row['route']} | \`{row['decision']}\` | {row['updated_at']} |"
        )
    if not rows:
        lines.append("| — | Open PRなし | — | — | — |")
    lines.extend(["", f"Open PR: {len(rows)}", "",
                  "自動承認・自動マージ・自動通知は行いません。保留も担当ソラが原因を確認してください。"])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def main():
    report = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = build(report)
    root = Path("inventory-output")
    (root / "pr-approval-routing.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"repository": report["repository"], "items": rows}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8")
    markdown = render(report["repository"], rows)
    (root / "pr-approval-routing.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")
    print(markdown)
    with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", os.devnull), "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
        output.write(markdown)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

    result = render(report)
    output.write_text(result, encoding="utf-8")
    print(result)

        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):

    def test_pagination_multiple_full_pages(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            page = int(path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1])
            if page <= 2:
                return [{"name": "branch-%s-%s" % (page, i)} for i in range(100)]
            return [{"name": "branch-last"}]

            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 101}]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 102}]
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            prs = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/pulls?state=all")

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            current = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value={"default_branch": "main"}), patch.object(inventory, "pages", side_effect=fake_pages):

        self.assertIn("NOT proof", result["caveat"])

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            cwd = os.getcwd()

                Path("inventory-output").mkdir()

                    json.dumps({"snapshot": {"branches": {}, "prs": {}, "issues": {}}}))

                                  side_effect=urllib.error.HTTPError("test", 401, "Unauthorized", {}, None)):
                    delta.main()
                result = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/delta.json").read_text())
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], "comparison_unavailable")
                self.assertIn("401", result["note"])

            finally:

            "https://api.github.com/repos/example/demo/actions/artifacts/123/zip",

        self.assertNotIn("Authorization", redirected.unredirected_hdrs)
